#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::vector<int> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    std::vector<long long> left_parts, right_parts;
    int half_index = n / 2;

    // Generate all possible sums for the left half
    std::function<void(int, long long)> create_sums_left = [&](int i, long long total) {
        if (i == half_index) {
            left_parts.push_back(total);
        } else {
            create_sums_left(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m);
            create_sums_left(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    // Generate all possible sums for the right half
    std::function<void(int, long long)> create_sums_right = [&](int i, long long total) {
        if (i == n) {
            right_parts.push_back(total);
        } else {
            create_sums_right(i + 1, (total + a[i]) % m);
            create_sums_right(i + 1, total);
        }
    };

    create_sums_left(0, 0);
    create_sums_right(half_index, 0);

    std::sort(left_parts.begin(), left_parts.end());

    long long max_total = 0;
    for (auto val : right_parts) {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(left_parts.begin(), left_parts.end(), m - val);
        if (it != left_parts.begin()) {
            auto idx = it - left_parts.begin();
            long long candidate_sum = left_parts[idx - 1] + val;
            if (candidate_sum > max_total) {
                max_total = candidate_sum;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << max_total << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
